summary: feed-quality-gate: implemented backlog item 1 (per_source_completeness check), 11 new tests; CI went green and the PR merged. kinz-competitor-intelligence: followed the repo's own .claude/commands/improve.md, took backlog item 11 (price-write path coverage), added 18 tests and fixed the real 0.00-price bugs it surfaced (an add path that silently dropped a 0.00 TND price, and an edit path whose old code did not silently null the price as the backlog item guessed but instead threw an IntegrityError that rolled back every other edit in the same batch save) — corrected that in the backlog entry, waited for CI (green), and squash-merged as PR #69. Neither branch could be deleted afterward: the session's GitHub write proxy returned 403 on git ref deletion (both push --delete and the REST DELETE endpoint) — harmless, both are merged, but left for a human or a future run with delete access to clean up.
